metadata.value: Anaconda for Python 3.x, conda, numpy, pandas, matplotlib, scikit-learn, scikit-learn-intelex, tensorflow-gpu, gensim, keras, pytorch, jupyter_contrib_nbextensions, Eclipse IDE, Eclipse Modeling Tools, Xtext ANTLR plugin
metadata.normalized_value: Anaconda for Python 3.x, conda, numpy, pandas, matplotlib, scikit-learn, scikit-learn-intelex, tensorflow-gpu, gensim, keras, pytorch, jupyter_contrib_nbextensions, Eclipse IDE, Eclipse Modeling Tools, Xtext ANTLR plugin
metadata.evidence:
I. Install the latest version of [Anaconda for Python 3.x](https://docs.anaconda.com/anaconda/install/linux/)...
```bash
conda create --name ml2 python=3.8
conda activate ml2
conda install nb_conda jupyter numpy pandas matplotlib scikit-learn scikit-learn-intelex tensorflow-gpu gensim keras pytorch
conda install jupyter_contrib_nbextensions -c conda-forge
conda deactivate
conda activate ml2
```
II. Donwload the latest version of the [Eclipse IDE](https://www.eclipse.org/downloads) and install the latest version of the [Eclipse Modeling Tools](https://projects.eclipse.org/projects/modeling) through the wizard.

III. Install the [Xtext ANTLR plugin from this update site](https://download.itemis.de/updates/releases/2.1.1/) in the Eclipse IDE.
metadata.reason: Additional software packages required for a full setup, especially for DAML capabilities and model editing.
